verdict.rationale: Muse's docs say the agent shops and checks out with online merchants "across the internet" and runs on its own computer with a terminal, which implies it completes tasks on websites. Nothing explicitly says it drives a web browser. missing for 10: explicit documentation of browser operation or automation, evidence of web research or navigation of arbitrary sites, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites

citations.quote: Link’s wallet for agents generates a one-time-use card so your real card details stay hidden, allowing you to purchase safely across the internet.
When shopping, a one-time card number is generated at checkout so your real card stays hidden from the merchant and your agent.
Muse has its own computer, with a file system and a terminal, so it can write its own code and build the tools a task needs.
